Differential Gene Expression

run_dge.Rd

Performs differential expression testing on single cell data depending on the class of the object passed. See the "Methods (by class)" section for details on the test used.

Usage

run_dge(
  object,
  group_by,
  layer = NULL,
  seurat_assay = NULL,
  lfc_format = "log2",
  positive_only = FALSE,
  remove_raw_pval = FALSE,
  test_use = NULL,
  sample_by = NULL,
  group_1 = NULL,
  group_2 = NULL,
  min_cells = 10L,
  robust = FALSE,
  slot = lifecycle::deprecated(),
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'scuba_pseudobulk'

Arguments

object

a single-cell object. Currently, Seurat, SingleCellExperiment, AnnData and file-backed SCUBA (scuba_source, see SCUBA::open_h5ad()) objects are supported, as well as pre-aggregated pseudobulk profiles (scuba_pseudobulk, see SCUBA::pseudobulk()) for test_use = "edgeR".

group_by

metadata variable to use for forming differential gene expression groups. A group will be created for all values in this variable present in the object passed to this function.

layer

The feature matrix layer to pull data from. If NULL, test-specific conventions will be used. The "data" layer is used for Seurat objects, and the "logcounts" layer is used for SingleCellExperiment objects. This parameter is currently ignored for anndata objects: only the "X" matrix may be used. The layer parameter is also ignored in BPCells objects.

seurat_assay

for Seurat objects, the assay to use for evaluating differences in expression. This is used only for tests on Seurat objects. For SingleCellExperiment objects, the assay defaults to the main experiment, and for anndata objects the "X" matrix is used.

lfc_format

sets the format used for reporting log-fold changes. If "log2", log-fold changes will be reported in a log two fold change format, and if "ln", log-fold changes will be reported as a natural log fold change. "log2" is the default value. Presto uses a natural log fold change by default, so lfc_format should be set to "ln" if consistency with Presto is desired.

positive_only

If TRUE, only display genes that are up-regulated in a group compared to the reference (LFC > 0). Defaults to FALSE.

remove_raw_pval

If TRUE, show only the adjusted p-value. Defaults to FALSE.

test_use

For SingleCellExperiment objects only. Controls which backend is used. NULL (default) auto-detects: "Presto" for in-memory matrices (dgCMatrix or matrix), "scran" for all other matrix classes (e.g. HDF5-backed DelayedMatrix, SVT_SparseMatrix). "Presto" forces presto via presto::wilcoxauc — errors if the matrix is not dgCMatrix or matrix. "scran" forces a true one-vs-rest Wilcoxon test per group via scran::pairwiseWilcox, indexing the result directly (returns an auc column; LFC from group means). "scran_pairwise" uses scran::findMarkers with pairwise comparisons combined across all groups (pval.type = "any"); no auc column is returned and log2FC is computed from group vs. all-other-cells means (same method as "scran"). For every supported object class, test_use = "edgeR" runs a sample-level (pseudobulk) edgeR quasi-likelihood test of group_1 versus group_2: raw counts are summed per sample and group by SCUBA::pseudobulk() (the cell-level matrix is never materialised), profiles with fewer than min_cells cells are dropped, edgeR::filterByExpr() and TMM normalisation are applied, and the model is ~ 0 + group when every sample belongs to one group (independent design) or ~ sample + group when samples contribute cells to both groups (paired design, e.g. cluster versus cluster within the same donors). edgeR needs at least two samples per group (or two paired samples; three or more are recommended). When a contrast is not replicated enough, the same call runs the cell-level Wilcoxon test of the object's class on the cells of the two groups instead, says so in a message, and labels the rows method = "wilcoxon" (see check_pseudobulk_design() to predict this from metadata alone). Pseudobulk tests error if sample_by yields about one cell per profile (a cell-level comparison in disguise). All other values preserve the existing cell-level Wilcoxon behaviour.

sample_by

Metadata column containing biological sample identifiers. Required only for test_use = "edgeR".

group_1, group_2

The two values of group_by to compare with a pseudobulk test. group_1 is always the numerator, so positive log2FC values mean higher expression in group_1.

min_cells

Minimum cells required in each sample/group pseudobulk.

robust

Whether to use robust empirical Bayes estimation in edgeR::glmQLFit().

slot

No longer used. Please use layer instead.

...

Additional arguments reserved for methods.

Methods (by class)

  • run_dge(scuba_pseudobulk): Pre-aggregated pseudobulk profiles from SCUBA::pseudobulk(): edgeR on the stored sample x group counts. group_by and sample_by come from the object; an unreplicated contrast is an error, because no cells are available for the Wilcoxon fallback.

  • run_dge(Seurat): Seurat objects: uses Presto

  • run_dge(SingleCellExperiment): SingleCellExperiment objects: uses Presto by default for in-memory matrices, with automatic fallback to scran for DelayedArray-backed matrices (e.g. HDF5-backed via HDF5Array). The backend can be controlled explicitly via test_use.

    Presto (test_use = "Presto" or auto for in-memory): calls presto::wilcoxauc directly on the extracted assay matrix. Output schema matches the Seurat/Presto path and includes auc, pct_in, and pct_out.

    scran one-vs-rest (test_use = "scran" or auto for non-presto-compatible matrices): runs a true one-vs-rest Wilcoxon test per group via scran::pairwiseWilcox on a binary factor (group vs. all others), then indexes the result directly by pair position. Returns an auc column. LFC is computed from per-group means (log-space subtraction). Requires BiocManager::install(c("scran", "SummarizedExperiment")).

    scran pairwise (test_use = "scran_pairwise"): uses scran::findMarkers(pval.type = "any"). No auc column. log2FC is computed from group vs. all-other-cells means (same method as "scran"). Requires BiocManager::install(c("scran", "SummarizedExperiment")).

    In all cases, avgExpr for scran paths is computed via MatrixGenerics::rowMeans2(), which supports both in-memory (dgCMatrix, matrix) and DelayedArray-backed matrices (e.g. HDF5Matrix, SVT_SparseMatrix). other_mean is derived algebraically from per-group means — no additional matrix reads per group.

  • run_dge(AnnDataR6): Anndata objects: uses Scanpy's rank_genes_groups function, with the "wilcoxon" method

  • run_dge(scuba_source): File-backed SCUBA objects (scuba_source, from SCUBA::open_h5ad() / SCUBA::open_h5mu()): uses Presto (presto::wilcoxauc) on the expression matrix served by SCUBA's Julia engine. The matrix is pulled through SCUBA::fetch_matrix() in blocks of features (options(scDE.chunk_features), default 2000) so memory stays bounded for large objects; the Wilcoxon statistics are computed per feature, so blocking does not change them, and the Benjamini-Hochberg adjustment is applied over all features within each group afterwards, as Presto does. Groups come from SCUBA::fetch_metadata(), so metadata columns added in R (e.g. by SCUBA::update_object_metadata()) are honoured. seurat_assay selects the modality (default: the main modality, "X" for h5ad files); layer defaults to SCUBA::default_layer() ("X"), which is assumed to hold log-normalised values like a Seurat data layer. Output schema matches the Seurat/Presto path: group, feature, avgExpr, log2FC, auc, pval, pval_adj, pct_in, pct_out. test_use = "edgeR" (pseudobulk) is handled before dispatch, see above.

Pseudobulk results

edgeR results carry a method column ("edgeR", or "wilcoxon" after a fallback) ahead of the common columns group, feature, avgExpr (average log2-CPM for edgeR), log2FC, pval, pval_adj, and an edger_details attribute: design_type ("independent" / "paired"), fallback_reason, sample_summary (retained and excluded samples per group), retained_profiles, excluded_profiles, the design matrix and contrast or coefficient, genes_tested, the TMM factors and how the counts were aggregated.
